overview: Cross-reference (1941): Japan held jurisdiction in Kwantung, but the US didn't recognize it as part of the Japanese Empire.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference on the status of the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.from: U.S. Consul at Dairen (source of referenced information)
subfiles.about: The sheet refers researchers to a telegram clarifying the U.S. position on Japanese authority and sovereignty in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: Japan exercised jurisdiction in Kwantung, but the US didn't treat it as part of the Japanese Empire.

interest: Index on Kwantung's administrative versus territorial status.
